name: Musicius
bio: Musicius is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no firm date for the poet. The index adds that the name is probably corrupt and that the epigram is elsewhere attributed to Plato.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 39).

poems.title: Book IX, 39
poems.author: Musicius
poems.text: Cypris to the Muses: “Honour Aphrodite, ye maidens, or I will arm Love against you.” And the Muses to Cypris: “Talk that twaddle to Ares. Your brat has no wings to fly to us.”
